stem: Which detail from paragraphs 15 and 16 of the story “The Farm Where Nothing Grew” supports the key idea that the farmer improves the land?

options.label: A
options.text: The townspeople have avoided talking to the farmer for weeks.

options.label: B
options.text: The townspeople go to the farmer’s land together.

options.label: C
options.text: The farmer’s land is covered in fruit and vegetable plants.

options.label: D
options.text: The farmer comes outside to see the townspeople.
